construction.source_and_cap_return_proof:
WHOLE-LAYER TWO-FRAME RETURN

Start from the independently reviewed AP4/AP6/AP12 square product source:
centers (i*d,j*d,l*H), with d=R(1+cos(pi/n)), full height H, and the two
proper native frames I,Q=diag(1,-1,-1). For every integer level l, choose
one symbol sigma_l in {0,1}. Assign the whole owner at (i,j,l) the frame
t=i+j+sigma_l mod 2. This replaces the registered word sigma_l=l mod 2.

This is an actual source family, not independent optimization of angles.
At one level, every unit horizontal neighbor has opposite type. Both
ordered types and both axial displacements are the exact contact states
already proved by the square source (literal midpoint contact vertices).
Every other planar displacement has norm at least sqrt(2)*d>2R, so the
complete circumdisks separate. Between different levels the whole closed
vertical intervals have disjoint interiors, because the centers differ by
at least H. No equality of the top and bottom polygonal rings is required
for this horizontal-plane separator. These statements apply to every
integer pair, for any two-sided binary word (sigma_l). Thus the full source
is valid, and any finite set of its whole owners is valid simultaneously.

The operation changes the frame of every retained owner in one horizontal
layer together by Q. Its inverse is the same operation. It preserves all
centers and complete vertical intervals; the same-level checkerboard and
all interlayer separators close exactly. It is a discrete remove-and-
replace whole-layer return, not a claimed collision-free rigid rotation
through intermediate orientations. The registered-ring source remains a
separate neutral control. Its full-ring equality is not imposed here.

For a self-host gate s and one common source translation delta*e_z with
0<=delta<=2H, a candidate word (i,j,l,sigma_l) is contained exactly when
all actual host walls satisfy
 a_fz*delta <= s*beta_f-h_{i+j+sigma_l}(a_f)-a_f.(i*d,j*d,l*H).
This is a closed interval, possibly empty. The complete integer bounds
come from contained centroids: |i|,|j|<=floor(sR/d), and
 ceil(-(s-1)/2-2)<=l<=floor((s-1)/2).
At a fixed phase, each layer has exactly two compatible alternatives.
Its largest possible owner count is the larger of their exact contained
counts. Different layers have the same vertical separators, so summing
these maxima is sufficient as well as necessary within this family.
Every tied layer alternative is retained as a factored complete decoder;
we do not identify distinct neutral frame states. All interval endpoints
and all intervening open intervals give the complete phase capacity.

The first bounded test uses only AP4/AP6/AP12 self-host N100 gates against
a fresh public and local-native snapshot. It does not assert global
packing optimality, nor cover layer heights other than the declared H.
Source credit: PingYou Ltd whole-layer return built on the retained
square-product sources. No first-discovery claim for the infinite source.
construction.native_evaluation: For each exact field coordinate x, evaluate its rational isolating interval at rho*x and store float(lo+hi)/2. The actual resulting binary rationals are then checked against every same exact pair and wall row.
construction.neutral_word_family: Sixteen marked complete geometries: each of four layer symbols is independently in{0,1}. All have the same exact scale4 and preserve every whole owner.

contribution.method:
This batch contains 32 fresh campaign cases: 27 strict nominal improvements and five improved native certificates for AP12 self-host constructions already known at nominal scale 4. The five certificate reductions are identified separately in the manifest; they are not claimed as new nominal bounds.

The constructions use exact balanced like/unlike antiprism row contacts and marked finite returns, whole-height layer words and vacancy returns, whole-block translations, whole-prism axial subdivisions, and the declared Catalan source-cell returns. Complete source geometry, inherited author credits, marks, frames, all host walls, pair separators and common restoration paths are retained. Classical mechanisms and published source authors retain their attribution; finite construction credit is PingYou Ltd.

The eight-owner AP4 self-host construction has exact feasible scale 42 - 28 sqrt(2). Its complete endpoint and a six-wall/five-pair contact circuit were independently verified. That circuit proves optimality for the declared fixed contact map only; no global optimum is claimed.

All 32 packaged records pass both verify_general.py and certify_general.py (64 checks), independent full geometry/source reviews, current public and retained-construction comparisons, and archive checksum/privacy/dependency checks. The trusted batch parser selects exactly 32 native candidates. Final comparison: repository dc0d6f3bea4c1a5d3ca1845dd1793fd5d9a19828 and site build 2026-10-15 11:27. Thirty cases were previously unheld by PingYou in the selected site records; two improve already-held cases. Submission does not itself establish acceptance.
